title: Steam Favorites
description: A full-stack application that allows users to manage their favorite Steam games through a personalized profile.
keyFeatures: Up to 12 favorite games per user
REST API built with Node.js and Express

title: Magic Academy
description: A full-stack fantasy academy platform built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Django. The application includes secure authentication, backend API integration, and a cloud-deployed CRUD system, demonstrating modern frontend and backend development practices.
keyFeatures: Responsive React interface with Tailwind CSS
REST API with full CRUD operations
Frontend deployed on Vercel and backend on Render

title: Sword & Knife
description: A 2D Web Action Game built entirely from scratch

title: Test of Might
description: Fast-paced 2D survival roguelike focused on responsive combat and real-time gameplay feedback
keyFeatures: Enemy AI and wave spawning logic
Health, damage, and death feedback system

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: A classic Tic Tac Toe game built with Unity and C#, featuring turn-based gameplay, a Minimax-powered AI opponent with occasional mistakes, and complete win, defeat and draw detection.
